title: USGS prediction of a La Palma collapse tsunami
place_text: La Palma Island; US East Coast

tellings.quote: And uh the US Geological Service has predicted that uh that would cause a tsunami that in some places would wipe out up to 26 miles inland on the east US coast.

plain: A collapse on the island of La Palma would set off a tsunami that could reach as far as 26 miles inland in places on the US East Coast. That, says a former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan, is what the US Geological Service has predicted. He tells Michels this from memory, without naming the study or saying when it was made. If true, it would mean one island's collapse could flood a large part of America's Atlantic coast.
